nodes.label: Knowledge Amp
nodes.gist: D's original design (taught by toyMaker, 2002 onward) for a new human intelligence, training, education and play network that concentrates assets across all users; a model of what toyMaker, and all of nature, use. Written up 2010-2025 as Knowledge Amp, Adaptive Heuristics and Intelligence Amp.

nodes.label: Intelligence is relation
nodes.gist: Intelligence is not owned by a person; it is evoked between people, in context, and only instanced locally.
nodes.quote: This is the real birthplace of the stuff we speak about with the word intelligence: it is relation. Specifically. Always.

nodes.label: Small, tightly-knit groups
nodes.gist: We are born, learn, prosper and are fulfilled in small groups where progress is visible and informs every member.

nodes.label: Invitation, not declaration
nodes.gist: Authority demands declaration (control, profit); intelligence grows by invitation. The internet began as invitation and turned to declaration.

nodes.label: The internet is a childhood
nodes.gist: The network is an accelerated developmental domain, like a child gaining language: every loss becomes ten thousand, and so does every gain.

nodes.label: Attention is the money of learning
nodes.gist: Human attention is a developmental superfuel; children chase it because it amplifies memory and connection.

nodes.label: Connotation is the key
nodes.gist: Minds are associative and connotative; today's tools are denotative indexes. Restore metaphor, ambiguity and association to every search.
nodes.quote: Connotation is the key to prodigy and intelligence.

nodes.label: Tools shaped like minds
nodes.gist: Minds take the shape of the tools they use, so put the burden of likeness on the technology, not the mind.
nodes.quote: I want technologies that work more like our minds

nodes.label: Users own what they make
nodes.gist: Users are the only real technology behind the internet; they should own the benefits of their activity, not be farmed for it.

nodes.label: Competition backwards
nodes.gist: Compete to raise everyone else's possible excellence first, and so your own. Promotion by mutual merit only.
nodes.quote: octopuses are intelligent because all of them compete not merely to excel but to increase the possible excellence of all others first

nodes.label: Verity over popularity
nodes.gist: Rank by truth, value and reliability, not by popularity or copying.

nodes.label: Burning forward
nodes.gist: Learning-forward: drop the shells that only bring popularity; keep what nourishes. Make only what is excellent.
nodes.quote: We make only what is excellent, and things that arent? Die.

nodes.label: No mimics, no masters
nodes.gist: The primary paradigm is mutual education. Reward mutuality and accomplishment, not individuality and appearance.

nodes.label: Return ambiguity
nodes.gist: Bring intelligent ambiguity back into learning and browsing: many vectors of extension, metaphor and meaning. Like Hebrew, use what is missing to enrich what is there.

nodes.label: Laughter as agreement
nodes.gist: Laughter is a wave of shared, pleasant agreement; what is its equivalent for social intelligence? Swarms of people raining together over methods and purposes.

nodes.label: Give roles, not jobs
nodes.gist: Nature and humans give you better algorithms if you give them roles. We have been given jobs instead of roles since language, print and money.

nodes.label: Server / One-Way Barrier
nodes.gist: An anonymising wall between users and the internet: shows the internet a "no one" face, composes each person's artifact, runs search, sentinel and social hub.

nodes.label: Interface (Intelligent Input Exploration Platform)
nodes.gist: Replaces the browser. Floats like two open hands: image rays on the left, text rays on the right, input and reception window between, synthesis controls below.

nodes.label: Connotation Engine
nodes.gist: Shows results inside a field of associated topics, images and media built from your artifact, with a dial from literal to associative.

nodes.label: Constellator
nodes.gist: Three wheels (imaging metaphor cloud, linguistic metaphor cloud, conceptual cloud) whose front five items link into a constellation under the input bar; spin a wheel and the constellation changes.

nodes.label: Linguistic Analysis / Etymology AI
nodes.gist: A window above the input that shows the etymology, synonyms, metaphors and analogies of whatever you type, so every search deepens your language.

nodes.label: Intelligence Artifact
nodes.gist: A locally stored, encrypted, ever-growing record of one person's (or group's) electronic life and analytics: their "secondary mind". Layered from fully public to fully private; can be linked, blended, sold by layer, and used as identity.

nodes.label: Vetting Sentinel
nodes.gist: A forensic toolbox trained by people that overlays any media with its pedigree, verity, rhetoric, purpose and beneficiaries; makes lying and copying expensive.

nodes.label: Passforge (Identity Agent)
nodes.gist: Identity proven by your own unfakeable activity, stored in your artifact; recognises its author only and can replace passwords.

nodes.label: Social Networking Agent
nodes.gist: Forum, adventure system, identity map and learning environment in one, connected to each person's artifact.

nodes.label: Social Adventuring System
nodes.gist: Avatars form teams, take on meaningful roles and compete to solve real-world problems, with badges, levels and classes earned by merit.

nodes.label: Data democracy investment system
nodes.gist: User-owned search and social systems that pay users dividends in cash and intelligence every time they are used.

nodes.label: Pods, scouts, predators, mimics
nodes.gist: Linked rings of small groups bound by purpose; scouts or orbitals bring in outside news and gain powers; predators may be neutral, aggressive or mimetic; elders and kids are types.

nodes.label: Travelling into constellations
nodes.gist: Search fills the front of each ray; pick a few results and press proceed, and they become the next input, so you travel level by level instead of reading a list.

nodes.label: The newscast vetting
nodes.gist: Watch a newscast; the Sentinel transcribes it and builds forensic overlays; you score earlier evaluations, add your own and are credited when it is outed as propaganda. A Sherlock Holmes adventure from one video.

nodes.label: Searching as someone else
nodes.gist: Search as yourself, as a friend, as a blend of people, or as a composite of the dead (Einstein, Socrates) built from their records.

nodes.label: Swarms re-resolving in waves
nodes.gist: Learning comes in wave-like reintroductions of the same ideas from shifting perspectives: multiple passes, re-recognising.

nodes.label: Trance
nodes.gist: A pulsed, wave-like group dance of focused attention that celebrates every member, rewards diversity and keeps honesty without rules; collapsing it onto one person breaks it.

nodes.label: The peripheral forest
nodes.gist: At D's desk, videos sit to the left and books to the right, like a forest walk to the screen, until the flat rectangle strips it away. KA restores that periphery.

nodes.label: Intelligence is Between Us
nodes.gist: Title node of the ASL map: intelligence is the mutual pursuit of trusted insight, recognition and advancement.

nodes.label: dream in dataspace
nodes.gist: Explore by constellation and metaphor instead of index and list.

nodes.label: mindright
nodes.gist: Not copyright: ownership of the intelligence your activity makes.

nodes.label: metaphy / metaphication
nodes.gist: Turning data relationships into metaphor: dimensions of knowledge, flow instead of stasis.

nodes.label: rhetological
nodes.gist: Rhetoric plus logic: analysis of how speech persuades; a planned markup language.

nodes.label: HACH
nodes.gist: Human-Assisted Computational Heuristics: D's name for what is usually called AI or machine learning, with people training it.

nodes.label: dataGiants, infoMonsters, infoserfs
nodes.gist: The giants who farm data and the users who build their pyramids.

nodes.label: accelerated developmental domain
nodes.gist: The internet seen as a sped-up childhood.

nodes.label: liquid government
nodes.gist: A context-sensitive superposition of governing intelligences that is trustworthy by the nature of its organs.

nodes.label: learning-avatars
nodes.gist: Avatars of intelligence and sensing, not persona; they compete as informational superheroes and fight in digital space instead of physical.

nodes.label: para-users
nodes.gist: Theoretical users composited from shared layers of several artifacts.

nodes.label: IPR
nodes.gist: Intimate, purposive, relational: what intelligence is, and what computation is not.
nodes.quote: Intelligence is intimate, purposive, and relational. IPR.
nodes.src: There is too much to tell. A.textClipping

nodes.label: superGroups
nodes.gist: Group intelligence flows down to individuals, who improve it with every move, inside constellated superGroups.
nodes.src: Int Amp Cuts/They do the opposite of what.textClipping

nodes.label: The nature-cost lens
nodes.gist: An augmented-reality game, like seeing Pokemon through a phone, that shows the cost or benefit to nature and community of any product or business; you win by preserving them through your choices.
nodes.src: Just as people are able to p.textClipping

nodes.label: The burning-building photo
nodes.gist: Searching for a fire photo, the Sentinel shows where and by whom it was taken and that copies were doctored; you are credited, the fakes and their sites are devalued, and the internet gets smarter.
nodes.src: You are looking for an image.textClipping

nodes.label: Surveillance as an asset
nodes.gist: Minds are born in loving surveillance: parents, peers and imaginary friends watching, and we imagine what they'd think. KA turns surveillance from a tool for selling and prosecuting into one that builds our own intelligence.
nodes.quote: surveillance is an asset that we can use to build new forms of intelligence
nodes.src: Sketching The Knowledge Amp_ A Mutual Intelligence Synthesis Engine.mp4

nodes.label: Memory is not storage
nodes.gist: Minds work like dreaming or forests, not dictionaries; if we do not dream we cannot learn, and we die. Search that retrains us to think in flat lists damages intelligence.
nodes.quote: Memory is not storage, it is like constellations of living gardens.
nodes.src: There is too much to tell. A.textClipping

nodes.label: mutual superfunction
nodes.gist: What a tightly knit team (like a sports team) reaches when its members watch each other closely: perception and action beyond normal function. KA aims that at real problems, not scoreboards.
nodes.src: Sketching The Knowledge Amp_ A Mutual Intelligence Synthesis Engine.mp4

nodes.gist: D's 2013 summary of what KA is for: making the music of human intelligence together, mostly just by talking, watching and reading.

nodes.title: Sketching The Knowledge Amp: A Mutual Intelligence Synthesis Engine (2013)

Twelve chapters: introduction, surveillance, lies, the browser, our minds, our browser, personal intelligence amplifier, personal intelligence assistant, social networking, vetting sentinel, heroic identities, outro.
